intro.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Parsippany, NJ, run by an owner who listens
paragraphs: JGK Home Improvement LLC is a contractor serving Parsippany and Morris County, NJ. Bathroom remodeling is the job our customers bring up most in their Google reviews, followed closely by decks and doors. Jason owns the company and stays involved from the first visit to the last day.

Homeowners notice how we run a job. One couple says Jason was responsive, knowledgeable and patient with all their questions, and offered several options along the way. Another family says we kept them in the loop at every step while we sorted out their storm door. A third had his whole deck replaced in three days by a crew that put every piece of furniture back where he wanted it.

items.name: Vincent M.
items.text: JGK Home Improvement is a fantastic company. We had our deck replaced and Jason the owner was so easy to work with! Very responsive, very knowledgeable and very patient with all of our questions. He provided multiple suggestions and options throughout the process. The quality of the work was top level and the workers were fantastic as well. They never left a mess and cleaned up every day before leaving. Absolutely beautiful and significant upgrade from our old wood deck to the new composite. We even added accent lights. I highly recommend JGK home improvement. You will be highly satisfied with the professionalism and quality of work. Jason is true to his word which is very hard to come by these days!  I never write reviews but this one I had to given how happy my wife and I are with the results.

items.name: Steve F.
items.text:
Couldn't be happier with JGK Home Improvements and Jason's crew — 5 stars all the way!

After reaching out to multiple contractors (and getting ghosted by most of them), Jason was one of the few who actually responded and came out to give an estimate. Not only did he show up, his quote came in around 30% less than the others I received. I gave the competition a chance to negotiate and they declined, so the choice was easy.
We agreed on pricing and a general timeline. Crew showed up April 15th and had everything wrapped up by midday April 18th — three days for a full deck replacement, which was way faster than expected. Every piece of furniture was taken off and placed back exactly where we wanted it when they were done.
The finished deck looks fantastic. Jason and his crew, led by Santos, were professional, incredibly tidy, and quiet throughout the whole job. Genuinely one of the easiest contractor experiences I've had. Would absolutely hire them again and will be recommending to anyone who asks!

items.name: Michael W.
items.text:
Exceptional Service and Craftsmanship!

I cannot say enough good things about Jason and his crew at JGK Home Improvement. From start to finish, the entire experience was wonderful. It is rare to find a team that is both extremely professional and genuinely friendly, but they hit the mark on both counts. We felt completely comfortable having them in our home.

We had an issue with our storm door, and Jason went above and beyond to get it resolved. What really stood out was their communication; they kept us in the loop every step of the way and did everything in their power to make sure the final result was perfect.

Their attention to detail and dedication to customer satisfaction are second to none. We are so appreciative of their hard work and the high quality of the results. If you are looking for a reliable, skilled, and honest contractor in Morris County, I would highly recommend JGK Home Improvement!

service_area.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Parsippany and Morris County
service_area.text: JGK Home Improvement LLC works in Parsippany and across Morris County, NJ. Customers from the county have hired us for bathroom remodels, deck replacements and door work. If you live nearby and are not sure we cover your street, call (973) 970-8847 between 8 AM and 5 PM, Monday through Saturday, and tell us where you are. Mention the project you have in mind too, so we can plan the estimate visit around it.

items.q: What kinds of projects does JGK take on?
items.a: Our Google reviews mention bathroom remodels most often, along with deck installation and door installation. We have replaced old wood decks with composite, added deck accent lights, installed new front doors and resolved a storm door problem. Call us to talk about your project.

items.q: How long does a deck replacement take?
items.a: It depends on the size and materials. For one customer, the crew showed up on April 15 and had a full deck replacement wrapped up by midday April 18, which he says was way faster than he expected. We will give you a general timeline before work starts.

items.q: Will the crew keep my home clean?
items.a: Yes. Cleaning up at the end of each day is part of how the crew works. One homeowner says the crew was incredibly tidy and quiet, and that every piece of furniture was taken off the deck and put back exactly where he wanted it at the end.

We work in Parsippany and throughout Morris County, NJ. One customer found us while looking for a reliable, skilled and honest contractor in Morris County. If you live close by and are not sure whether we come to your area, call (973) 970-8847 and ask.

We are open Monday through Saturday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed on Sunday. Call (973) 970-8847 during those hours, email jasonk@jgkhomeimprovement.com or message us on Facebook to set up an estimate visit. Jason will get back to you to find a time that works.

final_cta.h2: Planning a bathroom, deck or new door?
final_cta.text: Call Jason to set up an estimate visit in Parsippany or anywhere in Morris County.
